Hi Alex — thanks for the screenshot, that helped. Coupa in our configuration is standard supplier login (email/password); we don't require SSO for suppliers at this stage. The "duplicate email" message usually means that email already exists on a different supplier profile or was previously used to sign up.

Options to resolve quickly: 
1) Use a different address (procurement@novuscomponents.com) to accept the invite — easiest short-term. If you want us to reissue the invite to that address, reply with the exact email and we'll send it from procurement operations.
2) If you prefer to keep marketplace@novuscomponents.com, Marissa can open a Coupa support ticket to merge or release the existing account. That usually takes 24–48 hours depending on Coupa response.

Marissa — can you open a support ticket (SUP-7891) and check the supplier index for Novus? If there is an old supplier record using Alex's email we can request an email release. I've looped in Ben from Sales because they mentioned the PO timing — Ben, is the PO issuance flexible if we need the 24–48 hour support turnaround?

Alex, if you want us to reissue to procurement@novuscomponents.com, reply-all with the target address and I'll trigger the invite now. I'll also attach a direct invite link in a follow-up message.

Thanks,
Evelyn
